newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Larsen & Toubro placement oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: India's Larsen & Toubro placement oversubscribed.

text.p: BOMBAY, June 8 (Reuter - India's engineering conglomerate Larsen & Toubro said on Sunday its one billion rupee private placement of debentures had been 50 percent oversubscribed and the company had exercised a greenshoe option to retain the extra 500 million rupees.
The debentures have a maturity of five years and carry a coupon of 14.5 percent, payable half yearly. The offer gave no front end incentives.
The placement was aranged by DSP Merrill Lynch Ltd and SBI Capital Markets Ltd, and L&T Finance Ltd were co-arrangers.
